posts.title: Orchestrators and teams are an AI anti-pattern
posts.description: Most of the companies selling "agent" tooling, OpenAI included, are missing the point. Open their docs and you'll find the same diagram: an orchestrator agent at the top, a team of specialised agents underneath, each with its own role and its own prompt. The research agent.
